name: Subura Street Thug

special_rules.name: Dirty Fighter
special_rules.description: Once per scene, a melee hit also gains the Stun effect.

traits: Broad-shouldered, scarred knuckles, smells of cheap wine. Works for whoever paid last.
notes: Usually found in groups of three to five in the alleys behind the tabernae. Flees once two of the group are down.
